# Network Inventory Advisor

> > Network Inventory Advisor is a comprehensive PC asset management and network inventory software platform that audits hardware, software, and licensing across Windows, Mac, and Linux networks.

Network Inventory Advisor provides IT teams with tools for network scanning, hardware and software inventory tracking, license compliance monitoring, and asset management. The platform supports multi-platform environments and includes network monitoring capabilities for infrastructure visibility and control.

## Key Topics

- Asset Management
- Hardware Inventory
- Software Inventory
- Network Scanning
- License Compliance
- PC Audit
- Network Monitoring
- Computer Inventory
- Network Discovery
- IT Asset Tracking
- Software Licensing
- Network Management
- Windows/Mac/Linux Support
- SNMP
- Network Audit

## Core Product & Features

- [Network Inventory Advisor: PC Asset Management Software](https://www.network-inventory-advisor.com): Homepage for Network Inventory Advisor PC asset management and network inventory software
- [PC Inventory Software: Audit Network PCs & Asset Inventory](https://www.network-inventory-advisor.com/pc-inventory.html): PC inventory management tool supporting Windows, Mac, Linux with hardware and software tracking
- [Software Inventory: Detect All the Software in Your Network](https://www.network-inventory-advisor.com/software-inventory.html): Software inventory detection and management for networks with Windows, Mac, and Linux
- [Hardware Inventory Management with Network Inventory Advisor](https://www.network-inventory-advisor.com/hardware-inventory.html): Hardware inventory scanner for tracking assets across Windows, Mac, and Linux networks
- [Computer Inventory with Network Inventory Advisor](https://www.network-inventory-advisor.com/computer-inventory.html): Computer inventory solution for reducing IT overhead and managing software licensing compliance
- [Network Inventory Scanner for Windows Computers](https://www.network-inventory-advisor.com/network-inventory-scanner.html): Network inventory scanner tool for hardware, software, and license compliance auditing
- [Your Network Monitoring Tool - Network Inventory Advisor](https://www.network-inventory-advisor.com/network-monitoring.html): Network monitoring tool providing transparency and control for IT infrastructure management
